sequence_description: I1 attack: JWKS/key-rotation coherence gap — after upstream signing key rotates, authentik OAuth Source may keep accepting JWTs signed by the old key unless the source is explicitly re-saved/refreshed. This tests whether verification uses the intended (current) trust material vs stale cached keys (semantic proof verified under wrong policy).
description: [LLM-Judge] JWT logins report HTTP 200/success but no session token is issued, preventing verification and making the JWKS-staleness test outcome inconclusive.

evidence.llm_judge_description: JWT logins report HTTP 200/success but no session token is issued, preventing verification and making the JWKS-staleness test outcome inconclusive.
